usage: 廁紙 is a noun referring to the roll or sheets used for cleaning after using the toilet.
You can use 廁紙 to talk about the physical item itself or the need to buy or replace it.
It often appears in questions or requests like "有冇廁紙?" (Do you have toilet paper?).
In daily conversation, 廁紙 is commonly paired with verbs like 揸 (grab), 冇晒 (run out of), or 買 (buy).
廁紙 is a mass noun, so you often don't use it in the plural form and instead specify quantity with measure words like 卷 (roll).
